text:
Apple (AAPL) is NEXT Financial Group Inc’s Largest Position Posted by Anthony Miller | Apr 19th, 2018 
NEXT Financial Group Inc lowered its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 27.6% in the fourth quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 65,654 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 25,031 shares during the period. Apple makes up about 4.7% of NEXT Financial Group Inc’s portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. NEXT Financial Group Inc’s holdings in Apple were worth $11,111,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
Other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of the company. CWM LLC increased its position in Apple by 8.4% in the 4th quarter. CWM LLC now owns 75,219 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $12,729,000 after acquiring an additional 5,858 shares during the period. Baltimore Washington Financial Advisors Inc. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 94.2% in the 4th quarter. Baltimore Washington Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 132,103 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $22,354,000 after purchasing an additional 64,080 shares during the last quarter. Whalerock Point Partners LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 7.0% in the 4th quarter. Whalerock Point Partners LLC now owns 58,820 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,955,000 after purchasing an additional 3,866 shares during the last quarter. Strategic Advisors LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.0% in the 4th quarter. Strategic Advisors LLC now owns 63,208 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,697,000 after purchasing an additional 1,226 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Convergence Investment Partners LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 1.3% in the 4th quarter. Convergence Investment Partners LLC now owns 48,902 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,276,000 after purchasing an additional 623 shares during the last quarter. 61.35% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. 
AAPL opened at $177.84 on Thursday. Apple has a 52-week low of $140.45 and a 52-week high of $183.50. The stock has a market cap of $892,113.06, a price-to-earnings ratio of 19.31, a P/E/G ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year. 
Several research analysts recently issued reports on the stock. Royal Bank of Canada set a $203.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. Zacks Investment Research lowered shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. Monness Crespi & Hardt initiated coverage on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $235.00 price objective on the stock. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Tuesday, April 3rd. Finally, Goldman Sachs set a $159.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Tuesday, April 3rd. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $203.21. 
In other Apple news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201 over the last 90 days. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
